categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Carries the 'Private Broadcast' label and changes transaction relay behavior under '-privatebroadcast' by withholding unconfirmed wallet transactions from peer announcement and retrieval.
categories.rationale: Stops nodes running '-privatebroadcast' from deanonymizing themselves over clearnet by serving dropped unconfirmed transactions that only they hold. P2P treats transaction origin privacy as a high priority, and rebroadcasting dropped transactions undermines the privacy guarantee of the private broadcast feature.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Carries the 'Wallet' label and modifies wallet logic in 'src/wallet/wallet.cpp' and 'src/wallet/wallet.h' to suppress periodic rebroadcast and mempool resubmission.
categories.rationale: Prevents the wallet from re-adding dropped transactions to the mempool during startup, imports, and periodic rebroadcast loops when configured with '-privatebroadcast'. Without this fix, wallet transaction rebroadcasts leak transaction ownership against user privacy expectations.
